description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao' for managing EmployeeImmigrationRecord entities in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching immigration records related to employees.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
classes.description: DAO class for handling EmployeeImmigrationRecord entities, including CRUD operations and search functionality.

methods.name: saveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeImmigrationRecord, assigning a new recordId if necessary, with validation for recordId range.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeImmigrationRecord based on employee number and record ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeImmigrationIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns existing immigration record IDs for a given employee number and list of record IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Deletes specified immigration records for a given employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Fetches all immigration records associated with a specific employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Performs a filtered search for immigration records based on provided search parameters, with pagination support.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginator based on search filter parameters, applying sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of immigration records matching specific search filters.
